messages:
Hannah: dropped a focused prototype for the trace header + export flow — figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new/trace-export-mini
Hannah: intent: make header denser, reduce correlation-id noise, and give a single obvious export path that still supports formats
Priyank: quick copy check: 'Download snapshot' vs 'Save trace' vs 'Export capture'. I prefer 'Download snapshot' for clarity.
Luca: same. But we should show the actual format somewhere (small caption: JSON) so non-devs aren't confused
Marta: UX idea: primary button = 'Download snapshot' (JSON caption). kebab menu -> 'Download as HAR', 'Download full bundle (incl. KV)'
Hannah: added a compact size badge next to CTA: "~ 1.9 MB · 742 spans". it updates live when filters change
a11y-bot: auto-scan: size-badge contrast ratio 3.0:1 on 2045023478. Needs >=4.5:1 for small text. Also recommend aria-live='polite' for updates
Marta: good catch — I'll darken the badge and increase weight. also add aria-live and role="status" so screen readers announce changes
Priyank: permission gating: only users with trace:download can see enabled CTA. others see disabled state with tooltip 'Request access' linking to modal
Luca: keyboard flow: Search -> Filters -> CTA -> Kebab. Add shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S to open export modal. Focus should land on modal heading
Hannah: modal for advanced options: include check 'Include KV (may be large)' with recalculated estimate before submit. warning when KV selected
infra-bot: infra notes: export requests create background jobs. endpoint returns job_id + estimated_size + span_count. signed url for download TTL=600s. add rate-limit on heavy bundles
Marta: micro-interaction: when job completes show a toast: 'Snapshot ready — Download · Copy link'. toast contains keyboard hints: 'Press D then L to download' and is focusable
a11y-bot: toast should be announced (aria-live) and not steal focus unexpectedly. ensure it is reachable via keyboard and dismissed with Esc or after 8s with polite announcement
Hannah: correlation-id polish: collapse to first 8 chars + ellipsis in header. hover reveals tooltip with full id and copy button. add a 'pin' toggle to expand if user wants it persistent
Priyank: telemetry: events = trace_export_initiated, export_option_selected, export_job_enqueued, export_job_finished (include span_count + estimated_size). track KV opt-ins
Luca: copy tweak: tooltip on primary says 'Quick snapshot (JSON)'. kebab entries show full names and sizes if estimated (e.g., 'Download full bundle (est. 42 MB)')
Marta: accessibility checklist in figma: contrast fix for size-badge, aria-live on size updates, aria-label on CTA includes trace id, role="dialog" + focus trap on modal, keyboard shortcuts documented
Hannah: decision summary: Primary CTA = 'Download snapshot' (defaults to JSON), kebab for HAR/full bundle, show estimated size + span count with aria-live, permission gating for exports, collapsed correlation id with hover+copy+pin, background job + signed url infra, contrast and focus fixes per a11y bot. I'll update the prototype and add annotations.
Priyank: can we run a 5-person quick usability next Wed for label comprehension? I want to test non-devs.
Hannah: scheduled. Thanks all :raised_hands:
